It ca"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"lls a SearXNG instance's JSON API (`/search?format=json`) and maps the aggregated results into the s"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"eam's normalized `WebSearchResult`."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"This is an **implementation** package: it registers a provider into `ctx.web`, resolves an optional "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"API key through `ctx.credentials` or the process environment, records the auxiliary request in the i"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"nitiating Agent session when one exists, and does not register a model-facing tool. It is a function"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"/namespace plugin (`inject: ['web']`)."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Why SearXNG"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Self-hosted & private**: your queries go to your own instance, not a third-party search vendor.
"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"- **Zero per-search model cost**: unlike provider-backed search that issues a full model call, one s"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"earch is a single HTTP GET — cheap and fast.
- **Multi-engine aggregation**: SearXNG merges Bing, Br"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"ave, Baidu, Google, DuckDuckGo, … behind one endpoint.
- **Portable**: point `baseURL` at any SearXN"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"G — local Docker, a LAN instance, or a public one."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- A running SearXNG instance reachable from the DSH host (default `http://localhost:8080`).
- DeepSe"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ek Harness profile with the `web` seam mounted (every standard profile ships it)."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### One-command install (bundle)"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"The package ships a `dsh.bundle.patch` declaration (`cordis.patch.yml`), so a
single `dsh plugin add"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"` registers the plugin **and** switches the web seam to

Falls back to `$SEA"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"RXNG_BASE_URL` from any environment layer. An unparseable value makes the provider unavailable. |
| "},{"id":"p25s3","text":"`maxResults` | `10` | Upper bound on sources returned by one search (the seam also enforces its own "},{"id":"p25s4","text":"bound). |
| `language` | `all` | Search language sent as `language=...` (e.g. `en`, `zh-CN`). `'all'"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"` (or unset) omits the parameter entirely. Falls back to `$SEARXNG_LANGUAGE`. |
| `apiKey` | omitted"},{"id":"p25s6","text":" | Literal SearXNG API key, when your instance requires one. Prefer `apiKeyEnv` so no secret enters "},{"id":"p25s7","text":"configuration; a non-empty literal wins. |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `SEARXNG_API_KEY` | Credential reference "},{"id":"p25s8","text":"resolved per search through `ctx.credentials`, or from the process environment when that seam is abs"},{"id":"p25s9","text":"ent. A missing value is fine for keyless local instances. |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"The entry above is the base layer of the `web-search-searxng` Settings section: a user layer over it"},{"id":"p27s2","text":" reaches the NEXT search, because the provider projects the section per call rather than capturing i"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"t at registration. `apiKey` carries `role('secret')`, so it never rides a `describe()` response in a"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"stration. `apiKey` carries `role('secret')`, so it never rides a `describe()` response in any layer."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Rate-limit note (local Docker behind Docker Desktop)"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"When SearXNG runs in Docker Desktop, requests from the host arrive with the compose **gateway IP** ("},{"id":"p29s2","text":"e.g. `172.18.0.1`) as `REMOTE_ADDR`, not `127.0.0.1`. The SearXNG limiter would treat that as a fore"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"ign client and 429 the JSON API (`API_MAX = 4/hour`). This provider sends `X-Forwarded-For: 127.0.0."},{"id":"p29s4","text":"1` on every request; combined with `trusted_proxies = ['127.0.0.0/8']` and a `pass_ip` entry for the"},{"id":"p29s5","text":" loopback and Docker bridge ranges in `limiter.toml`, the local client bypasses the JSON-API quota e"},{"id":"p29s6","text":"k and Docker bridge ranges in `limiter.toml`, the local client bypasses the JSON-API quota entirely."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"If your SearXNG is remote (LAN/cloud), drop that header from the provider or adjust `trusted_proxies"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"`/`pass_ip` on the server accordingly."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Mapping"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"SearXNG returns no provider-generated answer content this provider trusts as `content`, so `content`"},{"id":"p32s2","text":" is omitted. `sources[]` comes from `results[]`: `url` ← `url`, `title` ← `title`, `snippet` ← `cont"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"ent`, and `publishedAt` ← `publishedDate`. Results are deduplicated by URL."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"Provider failures become `WEB_PROVIDER_ERROR`; caller cancellation becomes `WEB_ABORTED`. HTTP redir"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"ects are followed (SearXNG may 307 blob/redirect endpoints)."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## Request logging"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"Immediately before dispatch, a search running under an initiating Agent appends the log-only `web/se"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"arxng-search-request` session event containing the resolved endpoint and query (secret-free). Direct"},{"id":"p35s3","text":" programmatic provider calls outside an Agent have no initiating session to log."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
